name: anode
description: Background Windows desktop for AI agents: native GUI automation, screenshots and app testing.
long_description: Runs apps in a Windows child session with its own screen, pointer and keyboard focus, so an agent can automate native UI, take screenshots and run headed app/browser tests while you keep working. Requires 64-bit Windows 10/11 Pro, Enterprise or Education (or Windows Server with an RDP host) and a one-time `anode setup` as administrator. Shares your files, account and network; it is not a security sandbox.

tools.name: seat_lease
tools.description: Acquire, renew, release or check the desktop lease that coordinates agents.

tools.name: anode_guide
tools.description: Explain when and how to use Anode's tools; works before machine setup.

tools.name: seat_capabilities
tools.description: Report screen capture availability and known input blockers.

tools.name: seat_exec
tools.description: Start a build, test or server as a command job and collect its output.

tools.name: seat_job
tools.description: Read, list or cancel your command jobs.

tools.name: seat_wait
tools.description: Wait for an accessible control to appear, disappear or change state.

tools.name: seat_windows
tools.description: List windows on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_observe
tools.description: Inspect a window's accessibility tree, text and optional screenshot.

tools.name: seat_window
tools.description: Focus, raise, restore, maximize, minimize, move or close a window.

tools.name: seat_element
tools.description: Invoke, set, toggle, select or scroll an observed accessible control.

tools.name: seat_status
tools.description: Report whether the background desktop is running; never starts it.

tools.name: seat_start
tools.description: Start the hidden background Windows desktop (the seat).

tools.name: seat_stop
tools.description: Sign the seat out, closing every program in it.

tools.name: seat_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the background desktop's screen as an image.

tools.name: seat_run
tools.description: Launch a program, document or shortcut on the background desktop.

tools.name: steam_status
tools.description: Report where Steam is running.

tools.name: steam_launch
tools.description: Start a Steam game on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_processes
tools.description: List programs running on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_kill_process
tools.description: Close one program on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_click
tools.description: Click at a point on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_move
tools.description: Move the background desktop's mouse pointer.

tools.name: seat_drag
tools.description: Drag with the mouse on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_scroll
tools.description: Turn the mouse wheel on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_key
tools.description: Press a key or key combination on the background desktop.

tools.name: seat_type
tools.description: Type text into the focused control on the background desktop.

tools.name: gamepad_attach
tools.description: Plug in a virtual Xbox 360 controller, visible machine-wide.

tools.name: gamepad_detach
tools.description: Unplug the virtual controller.

tools.name: gamepad_set
tools.description: Set virtual controller buttons, sticks and triggers.

tools.name: gamepad_tap
tools.description: Briefly press one virtual controller button or trigger.

tools.name: gamepad_reset
tools.description: Release every virtual controller button and center its sticks.

tools.name: seat_show
tools.description: Show the viewer window so you can watch or take control.

tools.name: seat_hide
